Bug_Title: SIO: Unnecessary type check done using instanceof operator (SIO_SUPERFLUOUS_INSTANCEOF)
Bug_Details:
Type check performed using the instanceof operator where it can be statically determined whether the object
is of the type requested.
Bug_Explanation: The code performs an unnecessary type check using the instanceof operator on line 12. Since 'animal' is already known to be of type Dog in the context of showBug method, the instanceof check is redundant.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBugWithDog' triggers the bug by sending an instance of Dog as an Animal to the showBug method. The method incorrectly uses an unnecessary instanceof check on line 12, which the test case is designed to hit.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that both tests passed successfully, which means the code executed as expected without any issues. This suggests that the unnecessary type check using the instanceof operator did not cause any failure or incorrect behavior in the tests, thus not confirming the presence of the bug based on the test results.
